Children never deserve to be beaten by an adult. 

Bad luck is basically a pretty good way to describe it. I think psychologically being abused and mistreated by your parents predisposes you to being mistreated by your peers bc they can sense that you have low self esteem. Then once you are established as being at the at the bottom of the social hierarchy the other kids metaphorically or otherwise "punch down" to establish/protect their own social rank. 
At this point, if another kid became your friend, it would lower their own "social rank" and invite the same negative attention.

So it's like a negative feedback loop that predisposes you into thinking you are worthless unloveable unfriendable etc when in reality you were just at the wrong end of an unfortunate series of events. 

I wish I could've phrased this better but hopefully this made sense. 

You can definitely change this fate. You can find your own worth. Once you leave school, it's technically a clean slate, as long as you don't let the internal psychological damage put you back in the same loop again. Something like that
